title: River Trail Crossing Campground

services.name: River Trail Crossing Campground
services.desc: On the Clear Fork River, nestled in the foothills of the Appalachian mountains, River Trail Crossing is a quaint, privately owned campground. We invite you to visit River Trail Crossing - conveniently located only minutes from I-71 and Mohican State Park in Richland County, Ohio. Our campground is modern, offering full hook-up (water/electric/sewer) sites to primitive tent sites. We have pull through sites with 50 amp service for your BIG RIGS.
